evidence_scope.exact: Finite checks of exact rational constructions; universal algebra theorems are separate handwritten proofs.
evidence_scope.discrete: Counts of explicit endpoint families, not all FP32 banks unless a separate full-format proof is given.
evidence_scope.structural: Small fixed layout and protected arithmetic graph, not a completed compiler/backend project.
evidence_scope.response: Distinct attainable outputs and exact quotient response dimensions, not learning-performance evidence.
evidence_scope.BF16: Software RNE; no native BF16 certification.
evidence_scope.FP32: Local scalar CPU execution audited against exact rational RNE.
evidence_scope.excluded: GPU, general concurrency, arbitrary compiler optimization, full host-stack machine proof and later stages.
